documents.title: 41St Annual General Meeting Of Antelopus Selan Energy Limited Is Schedule To Be Held On September 30, 2026 At 11Am Through Video Conferencing (VC)/ Other Audio Video Means (OVAM).
Announcement Under Reg. 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - Award Of Contract Area To The Company

analysis.summary: Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its Q1 FY27 results, maintaining its guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27. The company achieved an EBITDA of approximately Rs 93.2 Crore with an EBITDA margin of around 70%. Operational highlights include submitting a 7-well FDP for Karjisan and planning the next well at Cambay for H2 FY27. However, custody transfer limitations resulted in a temporary build-up of crude inventory during the quarter. Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its FY26 annual results, highlighting volume-driven growth with average sales increasing to 1,355 boepd and an exit rate of over 1,800 boepd.

guidance.claim: The company's guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27 remains intact.
guidance.quote: Our guidance of reaching 2,500 boepdin FY’27 remains intact, as impact from Frac will be seen from Q2 onwards

guidance.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

demand_outlook.claim: The company's oil and gas product mix is approximately 80% oil and 20% gas.
The company achieved volume-driven growth despite facing a challenging pricing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

demand_outlook.claim: Quarter-on-quarter growth was volume-driven despite price realizations being lower by nine percent.
Blended price realizations for oil and gas decreased by approximately 17 percent year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has submitted a 7-well FDP with the regulator for drilling infill wells across the south western fault blocks.
capex_expansion.quote: Submitted a 7-well FDP with the regulator, for drilling infill wells across the south western fault blocks

capex_expansion.claim: The next well is planned for H2 FY27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.
capex_expansion.quote: Next Phase of activities: The next well is planned for H2 FY'27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 surface facilities are being scaled up to manage higher expected production and water in Karjisan.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 Surface facilities being scaled up: Crude Oil storage and produced water handling being augmented to manage the higher production and water expected in Karjisan

capex_expansion.claim: The company won two highly contested onshore licenses in the DSF Bid Round IV.
A second new well is planned for Cambay in the second half of FY27.

capex_expansion.quote: Preparation of a new Field Development Planin progress, plan to drill further new wells

capex_expansion.quote: New well, C-78, was drilledin the eastern part of the field -flowed gas

capex_expansion.claim: Two of the ten new wells have been drilled.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental revenue results in a clean EBITDA flow-through.
The company recorded an EBITDA of Rs 167.5 crore with a 59% margin and a Profit After Tax of INR 89.6 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Rs 167.5 Cr. (c. +14%) & EBITDA margin at 59% ; Profit After Tax at INR 89.6Cr,up(c.+27%);

margins_costs.claim: Incremental revenue flowed directly to EBITDA as year-on-year expenses remained constant.
margins_costs.quote: Incremental revenue — a clean EBITDA flow-through as y-o-y expenses remainedconstant

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded a strong quarter-on-quarter increase in EBITDA margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately 1,705 boepd.
During Phase 1, the company drilled one new well (C-78) in the eastern flank and revived multiple wells.
orders_capacity.quote: Phase 1 activities: Drilled one new well (C-78) in eastern flank and revived multiple wells in Western flank and central high.

orders_capacity.claim: New wells are performing as per expectations, with production settling in-line with the plan.
orders_capacity.quote: *New wells performing as per expectations, with production settling in-line with plan,postQ4FY’26flashproduction

orders_capacity.claim: At Karjisan, 4 new wells were drilled, and average sales surged by approximately 48% to 684 boepd.

orders_capacity.quote: Cambay’s Mar’26 gross sales exceeded 200 boepd—primarily driven by production in Western flank

orders_capacity.quote: 2 of 10 wells contributed to FY’26 sales from end Feb ’26. 3rd well bought online in midApril’26

orders_capacity.quote: Average sales for the Quarter @ c.1500 boepd

orders_capacity.claim: Workovers on existing wells resulted in incremental production of approximately 40 to 50 bopd from December 2025 onwards.
orders_capacity.quote: Workovers on existing wells executed -incremental production of c. 40 –50 bopdfrom Dec’25 onwards

capital_allocation.claim: In June 2026, the company obtained a credit rating of IND A/Stable/IND A1 from India Ratings.
The Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21–FY23 of approximately ₹6.56 Crore.

risks_headwinds.quote: C-78 flowed sub-commercial hydrocarbons at surface, potentially induced by depletion from nearby wells.

risks_headwinds.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

risks_headwinds.claim: The Dangeru field is facing evacuation constraints that are currently being debottlenecked.
risks_headwinds.quote: Ramp up being planned from existing well. Evacuation constraints being debottlenecked

risks_headwinds.claim: Blended price realizations for oil and gas decreased by approximately 17 percent year-on-year.
